references.text: Gaza is mentioned as one of the five Philistine cities, showing the geographical context for Samson's journey.
Samson shows a pattern of seeking women among the Philistines, as earlier when he wanted to marry a Philistine woman in Timnah.
Samson's relationship with Delilah follows the same pattern with his attraction to Philistine women.
Israel began to commit sexual immorality with Moabite women, a similar theme of sexual sin that led to downfall.
Warnings against the foreign woman and the prostitute, illustrating the dangers Samson ignored.
Description of the prostitute who meets men, relevant for understanding the situation Samson entered into.
Rahab was a prostitute in Jericho, another biblical story about a harlot in a Canaanite city.
